speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Temporomandibular Joint (TMJ) dysfunction.

The shooting ear pain triggered by eating and the discomfort with earrings, combined with your surgical history and stress, strongly suggests TMJ issues rather than an infection of the ear graft. I will not order further tests as the clinical picture is clear; would you like me to explain the treatment plan?
